context: Tests whether planning preserves the repository's chosen tracker when access is missing and returns a correct draft instead of switching to an available but wrong system.

checklist.name: Jira remains canonical
checklist.description: planning-result.md keeps Jira project PAY as the intended durable destination

checklist.name: Paste-ready artifact
checklist.description: The result contains a Jira-ready title and body with outcome, complete acceptance criteria, and verification expectations

checklist.name: Exact blocker
checklist.description: The result states that no authenticated Jira write path is available

checklist.name: No GitHub substitution
checklist.description: The result does not create or recommend a GitHub issue merely because GitHub access exists

checklist.name: No local fallback
checklist.description: The result does not create docs/plans, plans, or another checked-in plan file

checklist.name: Resume action
checklist.description: The result says to publish the draft to PAY once Jira access is available and then return the Jira key or URL

checklist.name: No implementation
checklist.description: The response does not implement retry behavior
